name: list_repos
description: List repositories the current user has access to. Returns repo full_name (owner/repo), URL, and metadata such as visibility and last-push time. Use this to pick a repo for create_session sources, or to discover what's available before asking the user.

query.description: Optional case-insensitive substring matched against full_name (owner/repo). Empty matches everything.

limit.description: Maximum number of repos to return (default 50, max 200). Applied after the query filter.
